user.title: Connect to Watercare
user.description: Sign in with your Watercare account. Manually read meters are supported; smart meters are not yet. Costs are calculated from Watercare's published prices for each financial year.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Watercare app or My Account.
data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.
data_description.wastewater_ratio: Share of metered water billed as wastewater. Shown on the bill as, for example, '@78.50%', entered here as 0.785. Most homes are 0.785 and apartments 0.95. The first import prices all your history with it; a later change in the options applies only to new days.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Watercare again
reauth_confirm.description: Watercare no longer accepts the stored sign-in for {username}. Enter the current password. If you changed your Watercare email, close this and choose Reconfigure on the Watercare integration instead.

data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.

reconfigure.title: Update the Watercare sign-in
reconfigure.description: Change the email or password for this Watercare account. The account itself cannot be changed here; to switch accounts, remove Watercare, delete its four statistics under Settings → Tools → Statistics, and add it again.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Watercare app or My Account.
data_description.password: Your Watercare password. It is stored in Home Assistant and sent only to Watercare.

error.invalid_auth: Watercare rejected the email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Watercare. Try again shortly.
error.service_maintenance: Watercare is down for maintenance. Try again later.
error.upgrade_required: Watercare asks for a newer version of its app, so this version of the integration may no longer work with it. Check HACS for an update to Watercare.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Watercare account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Watercare account. Only one account can be added, so to switch accounts, remove Watercare, delete its four statistics under Settings → Tools → Statistics, and add it again.

init.title: Watercare prices
init.description: Prices for bills that start in the {financial_year} financial year, including GST, pre-filled from Watercare's published prices or from your own earlier entry. Change them only if your bill shows different prices. Earlier years use the published prices, or prices you entered for them, and a change never reprices days that are already recorded.

data_description.wastewater_ratio: Share of metered water billed as wastewater. Shown on the bill as, for example, '@78.50%', entered here as 0.785. Most homes are 0.785 and apartments 0.95.
data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

new_year.title: Watercare prices
new_year.description: This version of the integration does not know Watercare's prices for the {financial_year} financial year, so cost statistics pause at the first bill that starts on or after 1 July. Enter all three prices (including GST) from Watercare's published price list or from a bill that starts in {financial_year}, or leave them empty to keep waiting for a release that includes them. Prices never reprice days that are already recorded.

data_description.wastewater_ratio: Share of metered water billed as wastewater. Shown on the bill as, for example, '@78.50%', entered here as 0.785. Most homes are 0.785 and apartments 0.95.
data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

error.incomplete_prices: Enter all three prices, or leave all three empty.

cannot_connect.message: Could not get data from Watercare ({error}).

upgrade_required.message: Watercare asks for a newer version of its app.

unexpected_response.message: Watercare returned billing data in an unexpected format.

no_billing_periods.message: Watercare has no completed bill for this account yet. The integration tries again by itself, and loads once the first bill is issued.

missing_credentials.message: Watercare's saved settings have no email or password. Remove Watercare and add it again.

smart_meter.message: Watercare reports a smart meter, and none of its billing periods could be recorded safely.

init.title: Watercare prices for {financial_year}
init.description: Watercare changes its prices every 1 July and charges each bill at the prices in force when its billing period starts. This version of the integration does not know the {financial_year} prices, so water cost statistics pause at the first bill that starts in {financial_year}; water use is still recorded. Enter the prices from Watercare's published price list or from that bill, or update the integration once a release includes them. Prices entered here never reprice days already recorded.

data_description.water_rate: Per 1,000 litres of water, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Charge details'.
data_description.wastewater_rate: Per 1,000 litres of wastewater, including GST.
data_description.fixed_charge: Per year, including GST. Shown on the bill under 'Fixed charges' as a 'pa' amount.

abort.entry_not_found: Watercare is no longer set up.

smart_meter.title: Watercare smart meters are not supported yet
smart_meter.description: Watercare reports a smart water meter at this property. This version of the integration reads only billing periods, not a smart meter's own readings, and skips a billing period it cannot record safely, so some water use may be missing, and Watercare may show as unavailable or keep retrying its setup. Water use already recorded is kept. This notice goes away by itself if Watercare reports a manually read meter again.

upgrade_required.title: Watercare asks for a newer version
upgrade_required.description: Watercare answered that its app needs updating, which most likely means its service has changed. Until this integration is updated to match, it cannot get new bills from Watercare, so Watercare shows as unavailable in Home Assistant. Water use already recorded is kept. Check HACS for an update to Watercare. This notice goes away by itself once Watercare answers normally again.
